title: A Graphical Criterion for Linear Causal Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2611.33950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The values of causal effects and counterfactuals are typically only partially identified from observational data in the presence of unobserved confounding. With discretely-valued variables, under certain conditions, sharp bounds can be derived by solving one linear program. This is then computationally tractable for many causal questions. In this paper, for every diagram in which each confounded component has at most two hidden causes, we give necessary and sufficient conditions for the sharp bounds to be equal to the optimum of one linear program for every (positive) input probability table. This algorithm is implemented in a new Python package, called "partialid", that allows users to compose assumptions, queries, and data to obtain sharp bounds in a computationally tractable manner.

translated_title: 线性因果边界的图形判定准则
translated_abstract: 在存在未观测混杂因素的情况下，因果效应和反事实的值通常只能通过观测数据进行部分识别。对于离散值变量，在特定条件下，可以通过求解单个线性规划来推导出尖锐边界，这使得许多因果问题在计算上是可处理的。本文针对每个混杂组件最多包含两个隐藏原因的因果图，给出了对于任意（正）输入概率表，尖锐边界等于单个线性规划最优解的充分必要条件。该算法已在一个名为"partialid"的新Python包中实现，允许用户组合假设、查询和数据，以计算高效的方式获得尖锐边界。
tldr: 本文针对每个混杂组件最多含两个隐藏原因的因果图，给出了判断尖锐边界能否通过求解单个线性规划得到的充分必要条件，并实现了Python包partialid以计算高效的方式获得尖锐边界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides necessary and sufficient graphical conditions for sharp causal bounds to equal the optimum of a single linear program in diagrams where each confounded component has at most two hidden causes, implemented in a new Python package called "partialid".
